description: List the signed-in user's Tock reservations (upcoming, past, or canceled) with venue, date/time, party size, and experience. Pass view: "brief" for one line per reservation. Requires a browser tab signed in to exploretock.com via the ContextMint Bridge extension.

view.description: "full" (default) returns the reservation records as JSON; "brief" returns one line per reservation: venue: experience (party of N) — <ISO date-time or "no date"> — <upcoming|past|cancelled>, inside the untrusted-data envelope as data: string[], with a "-- none" note for an empty page and "-- more" for a full one.

name: tock_list_reservations
